title: Test-run view jumps on refresh: 'Loading test-run history...' appears and disappears
outcome: Refreshing the test-run view keeps its geometry stable, with no flicker or unnecessary rerender, while first load, errors and an empty list stay clear.
acceptance: During a refresh with existing data, the view keeps showing the last data and does not show the loading line, so the panel does not jump; a behaviour test covers this.
First load with no data still shows a readable loading state, and an error and a genuinely empty list still show as they do today; behaviour tests cover each.
The fix uses existing state and adds no new mechanism. A before-and-after measurement of renders or layout shift on the real view is recorded in proportion to the change.
A review pair finds no Medium or higher, and the normal focused checks and gate pass.

completion.summary: Landed stable Test Runs refresh: existing rows/empty state stay visible, first-load/error behavior retained; observed layout jump reduced from33.796875px to0 in controlled real-App A/B.
